name: World Map
description: A world map made of dots, with routes that draw themselves between places.

props.name: routes
props.type: { from: { lat: number; lng: number; label?: string }; to: { lat: number; lng: number; label?: string } }[]
props.description: Routes to draw, each from one place to another. A place with a label gets a small name tag beside its dot.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Colour of the land dots. They are drawn at low opacity.

props.name: routeColors
props.description: The route gradient, from the first colour at the start to the last colour at the end.

props.name: dotSpacing
props.description: Distance between land dots in pixels, from 3 to 24.

props.name: projection
props.description: The map projection. Antarctica is left off.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each route takes to draw. Routes then hold, fade and start again, staggered.

props.name: centerLng
props.description: Longitude at the middle of the map. Use about 150 to centre the Pacific.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the map. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content placed over the map, such as a caption.
